apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.36.7 - THE NUMBER OF GROUPS CAN BE TYPED (and Website Update 81)
  - Meetings… → Prayer groups: the Number of groups box is no longer filled in again while you type; an empty or too big number is
    put right when you leave the box.
  - A change of the prayer categories (Set for the selected, Fill the empty ones, Save the categories) goes to the phones at once;
    before, only at the next sync. Groups already made show each person's category as it is now (make new groups to balance them).
  - The member portal does the same, and its Prayer groups card is in 3 numbered parts: 1 prayer points and groups (folded once the
    groups are made), 2 the groups, 3 on the screen.
  - This program's copy of the portal page: Website Update 81 (rules version 47, unchanged).
